executive_assessment.text: Subnational depth includes historical county loss records, southern Lika/Dalmatia precipitation projections, Slavonian agricultural sensitivity, and Zagreb/Rijeka flood exposure; different vintages and denominators are retained.

County indicators distinguish age, disability and low income, while readiness measures describe organizations and plans rather than demonstrated response outcomes. No observed climate-conflict pathway is inferred from national security framing.
